grade: Crianças bem pequenas (1 ano e 7 meses a 3 anos e 11 meses)
subject: Escuta, Fala, Pensamento e Imaginação
description_pt: Identificar e criar diferentes sons e reconhecer rimas e aliterações em cantigas de roda e textos poéticos.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes sons presentes em brincadeiras cantadas e textos poéticos
components.description_en: Identify different sounds present in singing games and poetic texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify the complete sequence of sounds in spoken one-syllable words

components.description_pt: Reconhecer rimas em cantigas de roda e textos poéticos
components.description_en: Recognize rhymes in cantigas de roda and poetic texts
components.cc_component_description: Recognize and produce rhyming words in spoken language

components.description_pt: Produzir sons, rimas ou padrões aliterativos por meio de brincadeiras cantadas e poesia
components.description_en: Produce sounds, rhymes, or alliterative patterns through singing games and poetry
components.cc_component_description: Blend consonant cluster sounds with vowel sounds to form single-syllable words orally

cc_matches.description: Segment spoken single-syllable words into their complete sequence of individual sounds (phonemes).
Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes).
Orally produce single-syllable words by blending sounds (phonemes), including consonant blends.
